lines.text: David says the king rejoices in the LORD's strength, and the LORD has not withheld his request.
The LORD welcomes the king with rich blessings and places a helmet of bronze on his head.
The king asked for life, and the LORD granted length of days forever and ever, with joy in His presence.
The king trusts in the LORD and will not be proud, and the LORD will place His enemies in a fiery furnace.
The enemies' schemes will not prevail, and the LORD's bow will put them to flight, so we will sing and praise His power.
